_comment: Data for core helpers/hand-step-gate.cjs (Stop check HAND STEP, and `--replay` over the transcripts): a hand step the reply gives the operator must be one only their hand can take, with what they have at hand. Patterns are JavaScript regex, case-insensitive. Copy to .claude/rules/hand-steps.json and fill it in your language; no file = the check is inert.
_addressed_words: A sentence with one of these words is an instruction to the operator (list items always are). Put your language's forms here, e.g. the second person and 'please'.

self_run._why: A code block in the reply for a command the AI runs itself hands the operator the AI's work (measured 2026-10-28: a flash command block for a board on the AI's own USB port). The check fires in the hook only while a device of device_globs is attached; the replay reports every case.

not_at_hand._why: An instruction that needs something the operator does not have right now (measured 2026-10-28: a multimeter step while the operator was away from the lab, a state the brain had in memory). One item per missing thing, for a window of days: words (what names it), since / until (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), why (said in the block). Empty = nothing is missing.

_example_item.why: the operator is away from the lab until 2026-11-01

not_at_hand._waits: A line that already says the step waits until the missing thing is back passes - the second way out the block names.
